rules.title: Free care to 300% FPL at large systems, 200% elsewhere; discounts to 400%
rules.plain: Washington hospitals must give free care up to 300% of the poverty line (200% at smaller hospitals), and 75% or 50% off above that, whether or not you have insurance.
rules.quote: not more than 300 percent of the federal poverty level, adjusted for family size
rules.notes: Large system: owned by a system with 3+ acute hospitals, or large bed counts in certain counties (RCW 70.170.060(5)(a)). Applications within two years of service use income at application (10)(b). 75% and 50% discounts may be reduced for assets (5)(c).
